Class AsyncFrameworkTest

@IsTest()
private class AsyncFrameworkTest

Unit tests for AsyncFramework. Validates Queueable, Batch, and Flow job lifecycle including enqueuing, flushing, submitting, publishing via platform events, delayed execution, retry handling, Schedulable execution, JobInfo wrapper methods, error handling, and collectJobInfo() integration with AsyncApexJob records.
